CODE RED P1 REAL EXECUTION. The existing provider-parser candidate is a safe no-model contract. This child is the proof that turns that contract into a usable semantic path.

Exact repository paths:
- provider-parser/README.md
- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/subprocess.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/SubprocessSuite.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/provider/parser/fake-parser.py
- fixtures/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/fixtures/wog/RealProviderVerticalSuite.scala
- docs/data/provider-parser/runtime-manifest.json
- docs/data/provider-parser/wog-coverage.json
- docs/data/provider-parser/heldout-coverage.json
- docs/data/provider-parser/real-transcript-ledger.json

No other path. Do not download a model, accept terms, enter a credential, spend API funds or choose a provider on the owner behalf. The first action is to bind an already admitted local runtime; if none exists, report the exact runtime or credential authority blocker and keep the deterministic fake as a transport court only.

Terminal gate:
1. subprocess transport is argument-safe, bounded by timeout and output limits, preserves exact stdout or response bytes, records every invocation and never logs source prose by default;
2. PinnedRuntime binds exact code, package, checkpoint, environment and configuration identities;
3. every one of the 50 War of the Ghosts sentences receives a typed checked-success or typed failure outcome, with honest denominator and no corpus-specific rule; the bead closes only if all 50 yield checked proposition evidence;
4. a predeclared held-out source reports coverage and alignment quality under the same frozen runtime and policy;
5. one admitted real transcript goes through provider outcomes, NarrativeCompilation and the existing downstream alignment path to one fixed answered question, with receipt replay;
6. cache replay is byte-identical and a foreign input, token echo, provider call, checkpoint, runtime or cached result refuses;
7. deleting the live transport and substituting the deterministic fake cannot satisfy the real-runtime or held-out courts.

Run the exact reference-scope-emitted JVM gate, providerParser tests, touched fixture tests, scalafmt and independent review. A green contract-only fake does not complete this bead.
set.title: P1R real proposition execution: pinned runtime, 50 sentences, held-out and transcript vertical
